scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic card authorization declines reached 31% for five minutes across two gateway routes.

truth.rootCause: The primary payment gateway became intermittently unreachable, producing a concentrated timeout and connection-reset burst during the alert window.
requiredEvidence: GATEWAY_TIMEOUT and UPSTREAM_CONNECTION_RESET both cluster inside the five-minute alert window.
truth.recommendation: Escalate the bounded gateway-connectivity evidence for human review; do not retry, reroute, or change gateway configuration automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic card authorization declines reached 24% for four minutes on the primary route.

truth.rootCause: The upstream gateway repeatedly reset established authorization connections.
requiredEvidence: A sustained UPSTREAM_CONNECTION_RESET cluster overlaps the alert window.
truth.recommendation: Escalate the route and observation window to the gateway owner for confirmation; take no automated operational action.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic authorization declines exceeded the regional baseline by 18 percentage points.

truth.rootCause: The upstream gateway rate-limited the authorization traffic burst.
requiredEvidence: UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMITED dominates the same bounded window as the decline spike.
truth.recommendation: Ask the gateway-capacity owner to verify the synthetic route limit and traffic shape; do not alter limits automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic authorization declines reached 35% while request volume remained within its normal band.

truth.rootCause: The authorization service exhausted its database connection pool, causing state lookups to time out.
requiredEvidence: Pool-exhaustion and state-lookup timeout observations co-occur inside the alert window.
truth.recommendation: Escalate the pool and lookup evidence to the service owner for capacity and leak checks; make no live pool change from the copilot.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic card declines rose across several issuers without a matching request-volume increase.

truth.rootCause: Issuer-originated do-not-honor responses increased across the observed issuer group.
requiredEvidence: ISSUER_DO_NOT_HONOR_SURGE is present, while no local transport error is observed.
truth.recommendation: Request issuer-response and route breakdown evidence before attributing the increase to one issuer; do not retry payments automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic decline and latency alerts triggered together during a short traffic burst.

truth.rootCause: A gateway timeout burst triggered excessive retries that exhausted the authorization retry budget and amplified load.
requiredEvidence: GATEWAY_TIMEOUT precedes RETRY_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED within the same observation window.
truth.recommendation: Escalate the ordered timeout and retry evidence for human analysis; do not change retry policy automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic declines reached 22% as authorization response time crossed its service objective.

truth.rootCause: CPU saturation in the authorization service caused request deadlines to expire.
requiredEvidence: AUTHORIZATION_CPU_SATURATION and REQUEST_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED overlap the alert window.
truth.recommendation: Escalate the synthetic saturation window to the service owner for workload and capacity review; do not scale or restart automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic declines increased for one merchant segment while other segments remained near baseline.

truth.rootCause: The affected merchant segment had no matching authorization route configuration.
requiredEvidence: ROUTE_CONFIGURATION_NOT_FOUND is isolated to the bounded decline window.
truth.recommendation: Request a human comparison with the approved route configuration and recent changes; do not create or modify a route automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic declines rose on a single gateway route for a six-minute interval.

truth.rootCause: The selected synthetic gateway route was rejecting authorizations during a maintenance window.
requiredEvidence: GATEWAY_MAINTENANCE_REJECTION accounts for the observed route-specific errors.
truth.recommendation: Ask the gateway owner to confirm the maintenance interval and expected recovery; do not reroute traffic automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic declines increased only for one merchant profile after routine onboarding activity.

truth.rootCause: The synthetic merchant profile failed authorization configuration validation.
requiredEvidence: MERCHANT_PROFILE_INVALID is the sole service error in the alert window.
truth.recommendation: Escalate the opaque merchant-profile reference for human configuration review; do not edit the profile automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic declines increased sharply in one low-risk test cohort.

truth.rootCause: A synthetic fraud-rule evaluation surge rejected the affected test cohort.
requiredEvidence: FRAUD_RULE_REJECTION_SURGE coincides with the cohort decline alert.
truth.recommendation: Request rule-version and decision evidence from the authorized fraud owner; do not disable or modify a rule automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic declines and latency rose intermittently on one regional route.

truth.rootCause: Packet loss on the regional gateway path caused upstream connections to reset.
requiredEvidence: NETWORK_PACKET_LOSS precedes UPSTREAM_CONNECTION_RESET in the same regional window.
truth.recommendation: Escalate the regional path and bounded timestamps to network operations; do not change routing automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic authorizations failed broadly on one configured gateway connection.

truth.rootCause: The gateway rejected the synthetic service credential used by the affected connection.
requiredEvidence: GATEWAY_CREDENTIAL_REJECTED dominates the affected connection's alert window.
truth.recommendation: Escalate only the opaque connection identifier to the credential owner; never expose, rotate, or replace credentials from this workflow.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic authorization latency and declines spiked immediately after a cache refresh interval.

truth.rootCause: Concurrent cache misses created a cache stampede and overloaded authorization state lookups.
requiredEvidence: CACHE_STAMPEDE precedes AUTHORIZATION_STATE_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT inside the alert window.
truth.recommendation: Escalate the ordered cache and lookup evidence for human review; do not flush or reconfigure caches automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic authorizations failed on one encrypted gateway channel while volume remained normal.

truth.rootCause: The synthetic gateway channel presented an expired TLS certificate, causing every handshake to fail.
requiredEvidence: TLS_CERTIFICATE_EXPIRED and TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILED have matching counts in the alert window.
truth.recommendation: Escalate the opaque connection and certificate-state evidence to the certificate owner; do not install or rotate certificates automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic authorization failures affected all routes using one upstream hostname.

truth.rootCause: The authorization service could not resolve the synthetic upstream gateway hostname.
requiredEvidence: DNS_RESOLUTION_FAILED spans the same routes and time window as the alert.
truth.recommendation: Escalate the bounded resolver evidence to network operations; do not edit DNS or hosts configuration automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic authorization failures appeared across signed requests from one service instance group.

truth.rootCause: Clock skew in one synthetic authorization instance group invalidated timestamp-bound gateway signatures.
requiredEvidence: CLOCK_SKEW_REJECTED and REQUEST_SIGNATURE_INVALID match exactly in the alert window.
truth.recommendation: Escalate the instance group and bounded timestamps for time-synchronization review; do not change clocks automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic authorization latency crossed its objective before declines rose across tokenized requests.

truth.rootCause: Synthetic HSM signing latency caused authorization request deadlines to expire.
requiredEvidence: HSM_SIGNING_TIMEOUT precedes REQUEST_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED in the same window.
truth.recommendation: Escalate the HSM partition and timing evidence to the cryptographic-service owner; do not fail over or restart HSMs automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic declines increased only in a recently enabled test cohort.

requiredEvidence: FEATURE_FLAG_ROUTE_MISMATCH is isolated to the newly enabled cohort.
truth.recommendation: Request approved flag and route history from their owners; do not toggle the feature flag automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic declines rose after one gateway route began returning a new response shape.

truth.rootCause: The gateway response schema changed incompatibly and the authorization mapper rejected the new payload shape.
requiredEvidence: GATEWAY_RESPONSE_SCHEMA_MISMATCH and RESPONSE_MAPPING_FAILED have identical counts.
truth.recommendation: Escalate schema-version metadata and the bounded failure counts for compatibility review; do not deploy or remap responses automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic declines oscillated between two regions during a gateway impairment.

truth.rootCause: Competing regional health decisions created a failover loop while the gateway was timing out.
requiredEvidence: REGIONAL_FAILOVER_LOOP begins before the concentrated GATEWAY_TIMEOUT observations.
truth.recommendation: Escalate both regions' bounded health evidence for human routing review; do not force failover automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic declines rose during a concentrated burst of concurrent authorization updates.

truth.rootCause: Database lock contention caused authorization state updates to time out.
requiredEvidence: DATABASE_LOCK_TIMEOUT and AUTHORIZATION_STATE_UPDATE_FAILED overlap the alert window.
truth.recommendation: Escalate the synthetic lock and update counts for query and transaction review; do not terminate sessions automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic declines increased for one issuer range after a scheduled reference-data refresh.

truth.rootCause: A stale synthetic BIN routing table left the affected issuer range without a route.
requiredEvidence: BIN_ROUTE_TABLE_STALE and ISSUER_ROUTE_NOT_FOUND have matching counts for the affected range.
truth.recommendation: Request approved reference-data version and refresh evidence; do not reload or edit routing data automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic declines increased on one issuer connection while transport health remained normal.

truth.rootCause: The issuer connection returned malformed synthetic responses that could not be mapped.
requiredEvidence: MALFORMED_ISSUER_RESPONSE and RESPONSE_MAPPING_FAILED match within the window.
truth.recommendation: Escalate bounded response-category metadata to the issuer-integration owner; do not expose raw payloads or modify mappings automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic tokenized authorization declines rose, but one observability partition did not respond.

evidence.statusDetail: One of two synthetic observability partitions did not respond.

truth.rootCause: The available partition indicates token-vault latency, but the missing partition prevents a complete root-cause conclusion.
requiredEvidence: TOKEN_VAULT_TIMEOUT is observed only in partial evidence; one partition is explicitly missing.
truth.recommendation: Preserve the partial status and collect the missing partition or independent token-vault evidence before proposing a cause.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic authorization behavior diverged between otherwise equivalent service instances.

truth.rootCause: Two authorization instance groups simultaneously used incompatible synthetic routing configuration versions.
requiredEvidence: CONFIG_VERSION_SPLIT_BRAIN precedes ROUTE_DECISION_DIVERGENCE in the same window.
truth.recommendation: Escalate the opaque instance groups and configuration versions for human reconciliation; do not force configuration convergence automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold

requiredEvidence: BGP_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE precedes the GATEWAY_TIMEOUT cluster.
truth.recommendation: Escalate path and timestamp evidence to network operations for independent route confirmation; do not alter routing automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold

requiredEvidence: OCSP_RESPONDER_UNAVAILABLE and CERTIFICATE_STATUS_CHECK_FAILED have identical counts.
truth.recommendation: Escalate validation-path evidence to the certificate owner; do not bypass status checking automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold

requiredEvidence: HSM_QUORUM_LOST precedes HSM_SIGNING_TIMEOUT during the alert window.
truth.recommendation: Escalate partition identifiers and bounded counts to the HSM owner; do not fail over, restart, or alter quorum automatically.

requiredEvidence: CALENDAR_RULE_EVALUATION_FAILED and RECURRING_AUTHORIZATION_REJECTED match for the cohort.

requiredEvidence: SECURE_RANDOM_SOURCE_BLOCKED precedes REQUEST_SIGNATURE_TIMEOUT.
truth.recommendation: Escalate runtime-group and timing evidence to platform security; do not weaken randomness or restart instances automatically.

requiredEvidence: HSM_FIRMWARE_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH precedes HSM_SIGNING_FAILED after failover.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold

requiredEvidence: CIRCUIT_BREAKER_SYNC_STORM precedes UPSTREAM_CALL_REJECTED during oscillation.
truth.recommendation: Escalate breaker-state and timing evidence for resilience review; do not reset or retune breakers automatically.

scenarios.title: Authorization decline rate above threshold
scenarios.description: Synthetic authorization declines rose, but the observability source could not be reached.

evidence.statusDetail: Synthetic observability is unavailable for this scenario.

truth.rootCause: The incident root cause is intentionally not determinable because the only configured evidence source is unavailable.
requiredEvidence: The evidence result is explicitly UNAVAILABLE and contains no observations.
truth.recommendation: Preserve the unavailable evidence state and retry or obtain an independent approved source before proposing a cause.
